acceptance.betweenRequestedLevels: effectiveModelId must differ across requested treatment levels
acceptance.providerModelAgreement: providerModel must equal effectiveModelId for every probe
acceptance.withinRequestedLevel: all probes must report one identical effectiveModelId and providerModel

nonClaims: Preflight establishes observed Provider routing identity only; it is not a model capability evaluation.
Preflight probes are not calibration or inferential task observations and never enter R2 effect estimates.
